tools.name: recommend_kit
tools.description: Use this when a small US trade or service business (plumber, electrician, HVAC, landscaper…) asks which software to use. Returns Kitfinch's recommended tool for each task (scheduling, invoicing, CRM…), verified entry prices with their source, and an estimated monthly total for the team size.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much a specific business software tool costs. Returns every plan Kitfinch tracks; an amount is included only when it has a source page and a recent verification date, otherwise the plan says to check the vendor site.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare two business software tools side by side. Returns both tools with verified entry prices, the tasks they both cover and a link to Kitfinch's comparison page.
